name: generic-resource-graph-productization-next-selection
purpose: Choose the next productization bucket after wave 2 without promoting anything yet. The selected bucket is the smallest coherent blocker set that already has exact live markers and support/refusal rows, and is blocked by one explicit missing product contract: full source/target tree identity.

deferredAlternatives.reason: These remain promising but need exact live product markers and enclosing envelopes before promotion. They are better handled after the static-root tree identity contract is modeled.
Service/database rows need service-specific safety contracts, config/package/root drift refusals, active-client boundaries, and database state policy. They are larger than the tree-identity batch.
